title: qq bot template preview request: which configuration to render, plus optional draft values and sample overrides

source.description: saved (default) renders the stored settings, which is exactly what a push would send, and ignores every draft field in this request; draft renders the draft values below.

template.description: Message template to render (draft source only); omitted means the plugin's default template.

format.description: Rendering flavour (draft source only); markdown escapes variable values, text does not.

signature.description: Line appended at the end of the message and referenced as {{signature}} (draft source only).

excerptLimit.description: Characters of the sample excerpt to keep, 0 hides the excerpt (draft source only).

maxMessageChars.description: Upper bound for the rendered message, 0 applies the plugin default (draft source only; the saved source always uses the stored value).

sample.description: Sample values to render instead of the built-in sample. Any field present overrides that field only; omitted fields keep the built-in sample value.

author.description: Sample author display name, referenced as {{author}}.

excerpt.description: Sample excerpt before truncation; it is still cut to the effective excerptLimit.
